business_problem: Decidr needed to turn scattered documents, spreadsheets, invoices, and operational records into deterministic business intelligence in hours rather than months while avoiding custom infrastructure work.
solution_summary: Decidr uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: Decidr needed to turn scattered documents, spreadsheets, invoices, and operational records into deterministic business intelligence in hours rather than months while avoiding custom infrastructure work. Google Workspace provides the Drive, Docs, and Sheets data sources that feed Decidr’s ingestion and translation pipelines, serving as the ingest layer. Gemini Pro reasons across long-context supplier records, invoices, and usage data to create structured intelligence and deterministic models, serving as the compute layer. Gemini 3 Flash supports high-speed real-time processing across cross-system data workloads, serving as the compute layer. Identity and Access Management delivers fully managed access control and reduces operational overhead for the platform, serving as the governance layer.

data_flow: Data from Drive, Docs, Sheets, supplier records, invoices, and usage systems is ingested into the Decidr schema through Google Workspace connectors, Gemini models structure and reason across the content, and deterministic models return real-time operational recommendations.
